history_window.rule: exactly 75 prior eligible sessions ending at immediately previous completed session

date_selection.rationale: This is the earliest practical XNYS session selected on 2026-10-06 that leaves thirteen full calendar days for review and deployment before the session. No data dependency requires waiting until October 26. No automatic rolling is permitted.

execution_location: normal moneybot-market-stream worker runtime with mounted /var/data; never GitHub Actions or a diskless one-off job

implementation.authorization_revision_binding: The final authorization is created outside the deployed revision after deployment. It records the already-deployed immutable Git commit plus these reviewed source hashes; the runner receives the final authorization file and its independently pinned hash. The authorization is not committed into the revision it authorizes.
implementation.correction: Runner accepts an independently hash-pinned session fixture and validates either legacy dated evidence or a registered experimental proxy contract. Unsupported membership/classification claims fail closed. Operational proxy use additionally requires explicit acceptance in an APPROVED authorization.

owner_review_checklist.action: Review this clarification, fixture, proxy binding, implementation source hashes, unchanged budgets, and command.
Deploy the reviewed immutable revision to the normal moneybot-market-stream worker without changing its start command.
Create a separate APPROVED authorization outside that deployed revision, bind the deployed Git commit/source hashes and all package hashes, and set owner_accepts_sector_proxy_clarification=true.
Only then manually execute once on the normal worker before the fixed cutoff. If review/deployment/approval misses the cutoff, do not roll the date or run.

remaining_blockers: Owner review and acceptance of the proxy clarification.
Deployment of the reviewed immutable implementation revision.
Creation and external pinning of a separate APPROVED authorization after deployment.
Runtime storage, AWS, Massive, backup/restore, capacity, and headroom remain unverified until the authorized bounded check.

sector_gate_finding.behavior: XLK history acquisition, alignment, five-session comparison, provenance, budgets, and all timing gates are unchanged.
sector_gate_finding.classification: AAPL classification is a separate descriptive fact; XLK membership is a separate dated fact; the feature requires neither as its gate.
sector_gate_finding.identity: Request 4 still independently requires an unambiguous security-level identity; CIK alone remains insufficient.
sector_gate_finding.membership: No current or future XLK membership is claimed.
sector_gate_finding.proxy: The computation needs a fixed, owner-approved experimental context series with six aligned dates. AAPL->XLK is configuration, not a membership assertion.
